text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: canary-error-rate spike on model-serving-prod (canary pool). Alert: 5xx rate 6.2% (>2% SLO) across canary instances. Metric link: https://grafana.redwood/users/sre/d/abc123

sara: I'm on it, grabbing logs and starting triage. Can someone confirm which commit rolled to canary?

Jing: I saw a canary deploy 1717654200 -> tag `canary/optimize-kv` about 7m ago. Likely culprit.

sara: Ok. Impact: some inference requests returning 502s, overall latency elevated. Not yet customer-facing throttle but we should kill the new feature flag for safety.

ops-lead: Agreed. Kill flag `feature.kv_prefetch` on canary only, then assess. @tom can you run the kill?

tom: running:
```
$ curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  https://api.internal.redwood/v1/flags/feature.kv_prefetch/disable?scope=canary
```
Response: 200 OK — flag disabled for canary

tom: flag disabled. Observability: 5xx down to 1.1% in 90s, latency normalizing.

sara: Good. Ops-lead wants a single-commit revert for the canary tag to prevent recurrence. Commit: `3f2b9e1` (PR #1289). Can someone prepare a revert PR and request a quick hotpatch to canary? Keep it minimal.

Jing: I'll open the revert PR now. Branch: `revert/3f2b9e1-hotfix`

Jing: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/1302 — title "revert: revert kv prefetch change (3f2b9e1)"

deploy-bot: Deploy started for `revert/3f2b9e1-hotfix` -> canary

deploy-bot: Deploy success. canary instances now at tag `canary/revert-3f2b9e1`

sara: Verification: running smoke tests and checking metrics.

sara: Metrics look stable for 5m; 5xx < 0.5%, latency within baseline. Marking as mitigated.

customer-success: Heads up — small customer-facing impact observed for a handful of API calls. We're drafting a short note for affected customers and support.

ops-lead: Good work. Action items: 1) Merge revert to main once validated 2) Roll to prod via normal rollout with canary gating 3) Postmortem doc (owner: Jing)

Jing: I'll own the postmortem and include a plan to add automatic canary rollback on high 5xx and a stricter gate for this flag.

sara: Thanks team. Closing pager.

incident-bot: Incident resolved. Duration: 18m. Severity: Sev2 -> mitigated. Postmortem assigned: Jing
